rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an ordinary barrel or for the amount it holds, as in 一桶; it does not specify the historical tun-based measurement.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 muk6 tung2 lau6 gan2 seoi2 aa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the metal tube of a gun rather than the container meaning 桶.

example.english: The barrel of this gun is bent.
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 coeng1 ge3 coeng1 gun2 waan1 zo2
